shots.detail_en: CH winds the pocket watch on the rooftop before the open, its face forever one minute slow.
shots.sub: 这块表慢一分钟。父亲说，它提醒我——市场永远快我一步。所以，我不追。
shots.speaker: 旁白（长虹）

shots.detail_en: The opening bell rings as paper slips storm the hall once more — the second round of borrowed wind, green waves rising.
CH stands by the pillar with hands in his pockets, placing not a single order.
shots.sub: 风要吹的时候，我一根手指都没动。
shots.speaker: 旁白（长虹）

shots.detail_en: MANCANG spins in frantic circles at the edge of the crowd.
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: CH watches the board, his voice flat and unhurried.
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: Slow-motion tape: each green wave rolls in thinner than the last, like a tide going out.
The flip-board visibly slows, its green bars shortening one after another.
shots.sub: 风还在吹。可纸单，跟不上了。
shots.speaker: 旁白（长虹）

shots.detail_en: 散户甲 pinches his sell slip, hesitating, eyes darting at the weakening board.
shots.speaker: 散户甲

shots.detail_en: 散户乙 folds his sell slip into his pocket, glancing around furtively.
shots.speaker: 散户乙

shots.detail_en: Montage of the wind turning back — slips quietly withdrawn, cha chaan teng talk reversing, whispers spreading under the board.
The green waves run out of force as red flip cards spark up sporadically across the board — the borrowed wind blows empty.
CH closes the hand-drawn K-line notebook and lifts his head.
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: At the counter, RED hands CH the after-hours return slips.
shots.sub: 今天大厅的卖单，一半没成交就撤了。风，真被你放空了。
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: CH looks up toward the second floor, his voice very soft.
shots.sub: 影线收回来了。下一根——看实体。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: On the second-floor VIP gallery, XIONG slowly lowers his telescope — his smile disappears for the first time as he truly faces the young man below.
Extreme close-up of the prayer beads dead still on XIONG's wrist.
shots.sub: 这个年轻人……比行情难读。
shots.speaker: 熊天成

shots.detail_en: The glass of the VIP box mirrors CH's lifted face; two floors apart, they lock eyes in total silence.
shots.speaker: 旁白（长虹）

shots.detail_en: Cut to a midnight overseas apartment — pull back from a wall of cold data screens to reveal XIONGWEI calling up a file at the keyboard.
Close-up of the file cover glowing on screen: Sample No.1 — Lu Changhong.
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: XIONGWEI snaps his passport shut as the screen lights up a flight confirmation page.
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: Black card with the next-episode teaser.
shots.sub: 下一站，港海市。算法，要见一见 K 线了。
shots.card: 下一站，港海市。算法，要见一见 K 线了。
